summary: Honor both applied flag locations before allowing a fresh client request

replay.detail: No stored claims, receipts or request identities are rewritten.

schema.detail: Both outer applied and details.applied are already supported by the error envelope. No wire field or generated model changes.

rules.detail: Unknown or malformed present applied values in either location prevent definite-nonapplication classification, including for stale-fence and rate-limited shortcuts. A none result requires an explicit none and no contradictory present flag.

compatibility.detail: Existing helper signatures and details-only behavior remain. Canonical outer none is recognized; contradictory or malformed metadata fails closed. The original wire envelope is preserved.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart is needed for this client helper correction.

manual.detail: Consumers must retain an original uncertain request instead of creating a fresh one. A replay refusal cannot settle an earlier ambiguous delivery. No automatic resend is added.

recovery.detail: outcomeUnknown and notApplied now use the same conservative merged applied classification. Existing caller replay-unsafe defenses remain separate; no new replay-unsafe wire semantics are introduced.
